segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Blessing the Children:1
segments.html: <small>It has become a widely accepted custom for parents to bless their children on the eve of Shabbos. The placing of both hands upon the child's head when giving the blessing, symbolizes that the blessing is bestowed with fullness of spirit and heart.</small>

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Blessing the Children:2
segments.html: <small>For a boy:</small> May God make you like Ephraim and Menashe. May Adonoy bless you and guard you. May Adonoy shine His countenance upon you and be gracious unto you. May Adonoy turn His countenance toward you and grant you peace.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Blessing the Children:3
segments.html: <small>For a girl:</small> May God make you like Sorah, Rivkah, Rochel and Leah. May Adonoy bless you and guard you. May Adonoy shine His countenance upon you and be gracious unto you. May Adonoy turn His countenance toward you and grant you peace.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Shalom Aleichem:1
segments.html:
Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Yehudah said: “Two angels accompany a man on the eve of Shabbos from the synagogue to his home, one good angel and one evil angel.” When the person arrives home to find the lights burning, the table set, and the bed made, the good angel exclaims, “May it be God's will that it be so next Shabbos.” But if not so, if the the house is dark and in disorder, the evil angel exclaims, “May it be God's will that it be so next Shabbos.” The good angel is compelled to answer Amein.—Maseches Shabbos 119b
The custom of singing Sholom Aleichem, peace upon you, upon returning from the synagogue is based on the above Talmudic teaching. Since every Jew is accompanied home by these two angels, it is fitting that he welcome them into his home. Obviously, one should prepare for Shabbos in such manner to evoke the angels' best wishes.

segments.html: מֶֽלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן עַל־כָּל־צְבָא מָרוֹם. יוֹצְ֒רֵֽנוּ יוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית. אֲחַלֶּה פָנֶֽיךָ הַמְּ֒אִירִים. שֶׁתְּ֒זַכֶּה אוֹתִי וְאֶת כָּל־בְּנֵי בֵיתִי. לִמְצֹא חֵן וְשֵֽׂכֶל טוֹב. בְּעֵינֶֽיךָ וּבְעֵינֵי כָל בְּנֵי אָדָם וְחַוָּה. וּבְעֵינֵי כָל־רוֹאֵֽינוּ לַעֲבוֹדָתֶֽךָ. וְזַכֵּֽנִי לְקַבֵּל שַׁבָּתוֹת מִתּוֹךְ רֹב שִׂמְחָה. וּמִתּוֹךְ עֽשֶׁר וְכָבוֹד. וּמִתּוֹךְ מִעוּט עֲוֹנוֹת. וְהָסֵר מִמֶּֽנִּי וּמִכָּל־עַמְּ֒ךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל. כָּל־מִינֵי חֹֽלִי. וְכָל־מִינֵי מַדְוֶה. וְכָל־מִינֵי דַלּוּת וַעֲנִיּוּת וְאֶבְיוֹנוּת. וְתֵן בָּֽנוּ יֵֽצֶר טוֹב לְעָבְדְּ֒ךָ בֶּאֱמֶת וּבְיִרְאָה וּבְאַהֲבָה. וְנִהְיֶה מְכֻבָּדִים בְּעֵינֶֽיךָ וּבְעֵינֵי כָל־ רוֹאֵֽינוּ. כִּי אַתָּה הוּא מֶֽלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד. כִּי לְךָ נָאֶה כִּי לְךָ יָאֶה:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Ribon Kol HaOlamim:5
segments.html: אָֽנָּא מֶֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּ֒לָכִים. צַוֵּה לְמַלְאָכֶֽיךָ מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁרֵת. מְשָׁרְתֵי עֶלְיוֹן. שֶׁיִּפְקְ֒דוּנִי בְּרַחֲמִים. וִיבָרְכֽוּנִי בְּבוֹאָם לְבֵיתִי בְּיוֹם קָדְשֵֽׁנוּ. כִּי הִדְלַֽקְתִּי נֵרוֹתַי וְהִצַּֽעְתִּי מִטָּתִי וְהֶחֱלַֽפְתִּי שִׂמְלוֹתַי לִכְבוֹד יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת. וּבָֽאתִי לְבֵיתְ֒ךָ לְהַפִּיל תְּחִנָּתִי לְפָנֶֽיךָ שֶׁתַּעֲבִיר אַנְחָתִי. וָאָעִיד אֲשֶׁר בָּרָֽאתָ בְּשִׁשָּׁה יָמִים כָּל הַיְּ֒צוּר. וָאֶשְׁנֶּה וָאֲשַׁלֵּשׁ עוֹד לְהָעִיד עַל כּוֹסִי בְּתוֹךְ שִׂמְחָתִי כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתַנִי לְזָכְרוֹ וּלְהִתְעַנֵּג בְּיֶֽתֶר נִשְׁמָתִי אֲשֶׁר נָתַֽתָּ בִּי. בּוֹ אֶשְׁבּוֹת. כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתַנִי לְשָׁרְתֶֽךָ. וְכֵן אַגִּיד גְּדֻלָּתְ֒ךָ בְּרִנָּה. וְשִׁוִּיתִי יְהֹוָה לִקְרָאתִי. שֶׁתְּ֒רַחֲמֵֽנִי עוֹד בְּגָלוּתִי לְגָאֳלֵֽנִי. וּלְעוֹרֵר לִבִּי לְאַהֲבָתֶֽךָ: וְאָז אֶשְׁמֹר לְפִקּוּדֶֽיךָ וְחֻקֶּֽיךָ בְּלִי עֶֽצֶב. וְאֶתְפַּלֵּל כַּדָּת וְכָרָאוּי וְכַנָּכוֹן:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Ribon Kol HaOlamim:6
segments.html: מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁלוֹם. בּוֹאֲכֶם לְשָׁלוֹם. בָּרְכוּנִי לְשָׁלוֹם. וְאִמְרוּ בָּרוּךְ לְשֻׁלְחָנִי הֶעָרוּךְ. וְצֵאתְ֒כֶם לְשָׁלוֹם. מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם אָמֵן סֶֽלָה:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:1
segments.html: אֵֽשֶׁת־חַֽיִל מִי יִמְצָא וְרָחֹק מִפְּ֒נִינִים מִכְרָהּ:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:2
segments.html: בָּֽטַח בָּהּ לֵב בַּעְלָהּ וְשָׁלָל לֹא יֶחְסָר:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:3
segments.html: גְּמָלַֽתְהוּ טוֹב וְלֹא־רָע כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּֽיהָ:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:4
segments.html: דָּרְ֒שָׁה צֶֽמֶר וּפִשְׁתִּים וַתַּֽעַשׂ בְּחֵֽפֶץ כַּפֶּֽיהָ:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:5
segments.html: הָיְ֒תָה כָּאֳנִיּוֹת סוֹחֵר מִמֶּרְחָק תָּבִיא לַחְמָהּ:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:6
segments.html: וַתָּֽקָם בְּעוֹד לַֽיְלָה וַתִּתֵּן טֶֽרֶף לְבֵיתָהּ וְחֹק לְנַעֲרֹתֶֽיהָ:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:7
segments.html: זָמְ֒מָה שָׂדֶה וַתִּקָּחֵֽהוּ מִפְּ֒רִי כַפֶּֽיהָ נָֽטְ֒עָה כָּֽרֶם:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:8
segments.html: חָגְ֒רָה בְּעוֹז מָתְנֶֽיהָ וַתְּ֒אַמֵּץ זְרוֹעֹתֶֽיהָ:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:9
segments.html: טָעֲמָה כִּי־טוֹב סַחְרָהּ לֹא־יִכְבֶּה בַּלַּֽיְלָה נֵרָהּ:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:10
segments.html: יָדֶֽיהָ שִׁלְּ֒חָה בַכִּישׁוֹר וְכַפֶּֽיהָ תָּֽמְ֒כוּ פָֽלֶךְ:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:11
segments.html: כַּפָּהּ פָּרְ֒שָׂה לֶעָנִי וְיָדֶֽיהָ שִׁלְּ֒חָה לָאֶבְיוֹן:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:12
segments.html: לֹא־תִירָא לְבֵיתָהּ מִשָּֽׁלֶג כִּי כָל־בֵּיתָהּ לָבֻשׁ שָׁנִים:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:13
segments.html: מַרְבַדִּים עָֽשְׂ֒תָה־לָּהּ שֵׁשׁ וְאַרְגָּמָן לְבוּשָׁהּ:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:14
segments.html: נוֹדָע בַּשְּׁ֒עָרִים בַּעְלָהּ בְּשִׁבְתּוֹ עִם־זִקְנֵי־אָֽרֶץ:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:15
segments.html: סָדִין עָשְׂ֒תָה וַתִּמְכֹּר וַחֲגוֹר נָתְ֒נָה לַכְּנַעֲנִי:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:16
segments.html: עוֹז־וְהָדָר לְבוּשָׁהּ וַתִּשְׂחַק לְיוֹם אַחֲרוֹן:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:17
segments.html: פִּֽיהָ פָּתְ֒חָה בְחָכְמָה וְתוֹרַת־חֶֽסֶד עַל־לְשׁוֹנָהּ:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:18
segments.html: צוֹפִיָּה הֲלִיכוֹת בֵּיתָהּ וְלֶֽחֶם עַצְלוּת לֹא תֹאכֵל:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:19
segments.html: קָֽמוּ בָנֶֽיהָ וַיְאַשְּׁ֒רֽוּהָ בַּעְלָהּ וַיְהַלְ֒לָהּ:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:20
segments.html: רַבּוֹת בָּנוֹת עָֽשׂוּ חָֽיִל וְאַתְּ עָלִית עַל־כֻּלָּֽנָה:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:21
segments.html: שֶֽׁקֶר הַחֵן וְהֶֽבֶל הַיֹּֽפִי אִשָּׁה יִרְאַת־יְהֹוָה הִיא תִתְהַלָּל:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:22
segments.html: תְּנוּ־לָהּ מִפְּ֒רִי יָדֶֽיהָ וִיהַלְ֒לֽוּהָ בַשְּׁ֒עָרִים מַעֲשֶֽׂיהָ:

en.version: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:1
segments.html: Whoever finds a valorous wife— far greater than that of pearls is her value.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:2
segments.html: The heart of her husband trusts in her, and he lacks no gain.4The literal meaning of שָׁלָל is “booty” which implies an unexpected gain to which one had no prior claim. Thus in our verse, although her husband had complete trust in her, her deeds actually surpassed his expectations.— S.R.Hirsch

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:3
segments.html: She repays him good and not evil all the days of her life.5A person can do much good to another and still cause him moments of pain or shame by his conduct. The true woman of valor, to whom this hymn is dedicated, gives her husband nothing but happiness, never a moment of grief all the days of her life.—S.R. Hirsch

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:4
segments.html: She seeks wool and linen, and works them willingly with her hands.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:5
segments.html: She is like the merchant ships; from afar, she brings her food.6These verses are a tribute to the woman of valor who is willing to do far more than she is required to do. Although her husband is obligated to support her, she does not hesitate to do everything in order to provide for her family.—Metsudas Dovid

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:6
segments.html: She rises while it is still night and gives food to her household, and tasks to her maids.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:7
segments.html: She considers a field and buys it; from the fruit of her hand, she plants a vineyard.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:8
segments.html: She girds herself with might and strengthens her arms.7She is not strong by nature; she “makes herself” strong. Her zeal and sense of duty give her strength and might.—S.R. Hirsch

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:9
segments.html: She senses that her business is good, [so] her lamp is not extinguished at night.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:10
segments.html: She puts her hand to the spindle, and her palms support the distaff.8This verse is connected with what follows. No time is wasted in idleness. Her other work being finished, she spends her leisure in spinning and making garments for the poor and for the members of her household.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:11
segments.html: Her palm she spreads out to the poor and her hands she extends to the needy.9An אֶביוֹן, a needy person, is in more desperate need than an עָנִי, a poor person. The woman of valor recognizes that. To the poor man, therefore, she opens her palms, permitting him to take what he wishes. But regarding the needy man, she takes the initiative by extending her hands to provide his needs.— Metsudas Dovid

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:12
segments.html: She has no fear for her household because of snow, for her entire household is clothed with scarlet [wool].

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:13
segments.html: Bedspreads, she makes herself fine linen and purple [wool] are her clothing.10She was attired in the costliest garments, as befits a distinguished woman.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:14
segments.html: Well-known at the gates11Oriental cities had deep gateways shaded from the sun. There the elders sat as a court to adjudicate disputes and discuss important communal affairs. is her husband as he sits among the elders of the land.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:15
segments.html: Garments she makes and sells them, and belts,12Like סָדִין a linen garment, חֲגוֹר , girdle, the noun is the collective singular. Sashes or belts were commonly worn around the waist. she provides for the merchants.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:16
segments.html: Strength and splendor are her clothing,13These characteristics are borne by her as one wears clothes. See Psalms 104:1, “With beauty and splendor are You clothed.” and smilingly [she awaits her] last day.14God shows the righteous, just before their death, the share they have earned in the World to Come. Thus the woman of valor will be joyous on her last day, because then she will know the fullness of the reward she has earned through her virtuous conduct.—Exodus Rabbah 52:3

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:17
segments.html: Her mouth she opens with wisdom, and the teaching of kindness15She teaches others to do kind deeds.—Metsudas Dovid is on her tongue.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:18
segments.html: She anticipates the ways of her household, and the bread of idleness, she does not eat.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:19
segments.html: Her children rise and make her fortunate;17She will feel fortunate and happy with the evidence of their appreciation and love. There is no more eloquent testimony to her virtue. her husband—and he praises her:

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:20
segments.html: Many daughters have attained valor but you surpassed them all.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:21
segments.html: Favor is deceptive and beauty is vain; a God-fearing woman—she should be praised.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Eshet Chayil:22
segments.html: Give her the fruit of her hand, and let her deeds praise her in the gates.18 Although her activities are confined to the home, due recognition will be given her even outside her immediate family. She will be eternally praised as a valiant example for the entire community.—S.R. Hirsch

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:7
segments.html: גַּם שְׂאוּ יְדֵיכֶם קֹֽדֶשׁ וְאִמְרוּ לָאֵל

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:9
segments.html: דּוֹרְשֵׁי יְהֹוָה זֶֽרַע אַבְרָהָם אוֹהֲבוֹ

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:10
segments.html: הַמְאַחֲרִים לָצֵאת מִן הַשַּׁבָּת וּמְמַהֲרִים לָבֹא

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:11

segments.html: זֶה הַיּוֹם עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה נָגִֽילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בוֹ׃

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:13
segments.html: זִכְרוּ תּוֹרַת משֶׁה בְּמִצְוַת שַׁבָּת גְּרוּסָה

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:14
segments.html: חֲרוּתָה לַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי כְּכַלָּה בֵּין רֵעוֹתֶֽיהָ מְשֻׁבָּצָה

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:15
segments.html: טְהוֹרִים יִירָשֽׁוּהָ וִיקַדְּשֽׁוּהָ בְּמַאֲמַר כָּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:16
segments.html: וַיְכַל אֱלֹהִים בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:17
segments.html: יוֹם קָדוֹשׁ הוּא מִבֹּאוֹ וְעַד צֵאתוֹ

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:18
segments.html: כָּל זֶֽרַע יַעֲקֹב יְכַבְּדֽוּהוּ כִּדְבַר הַמֶּֽלֶךְ וְדָתוֹ

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:19
segments.html: לָנֽוּחַ בּוֹ וְלִשְׂמֹֽחַ בְּתַעֲנוּג אָכוֹל וְשָׁתוֹ

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:20
segments.html: כָּל עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל יַעֲשׂוּ אוֹתוֹ׃

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:21
segments.html: מְשֹׁךְ חַסְדְּךָ לְיוֹדְעֶֽיךָ אֵל קַנֹּא וְנוֹקֵם

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:22
segments.html: נוֹטְרֵי יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי זָכוֹר וְשָׁמוֹר לְהָקֵם

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:23
segments.html: שַׂמְּחֵם בְּבִנְיַן שָׁלֵם בְּאוֹר פָּנֶֽיךָ תַּבְהִיקֵם

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:24
segments.html: יִרְוְיֻן מִדֶּֽשֶׁן בֵּיתֶֽךָ וְנַֽחַל עֲדָנֶֽיךָ תַשְׁקֵם׃

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:25
segments.html: עֲזֹר לַשּׁוֹבְתִים בַּשְּׁבִיעִי בֶּחָרִישׁ וּבַקָּצִיר עוֹלָמִים

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:26
segments.html: פּוֹסְעִים בּוֹ פְּסִיעָה קְטַנָּה סוֹעֲדִים בּוֹ לְבָרֵךְ שָׁלשׁ פְּעָמִים

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:27
segments.html: צִדְקָתָם תַּצְהִיר כְּאוֹר שִׁבְעַת הַיָּמִים

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:28
segments.html: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָֽבָה תָמִים׃

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:29
segments.html: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּשׁוּעַת עוֹלָמִים:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:30
segments.html: [קַדְּשֵׁם בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ וְטַהֲרֵם כְּעֶצֶם הַשָּׁמַיִם לָטֹהַר

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:31
segments.html: רוּחֲךָ תְּנִיחֶנּוּ כַּבְּהֵמָה בַּבִּקְעָה תֵרֵד מִן הָהָר

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:32
segments.html: שִׁבְטֵיהֶם תְּשַׁכְנֵם בְּנַחֲלַת הַסַּהַר

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:33
segments.html: כִּנְחָלִים נִטָּיוּ כְּגַנֹּת עֲלֵי נָהָר:]

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:1
segments.html: Whoever sanctifies the seventh day as befits it,

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:2
segments.html: Whoever preserves the Sabbath properly so as not to desecrate it—

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:3
segments.html: his reward is very great, commensurate with his actions;

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:4
segments.html: each man in his camp, each man with his banner.24Numbers 1:52.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:5
segments.html: Lovers of Adonoy, who yearn for the building of the Temple—

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:6
segments.html: on the Sabbath day be happy and rejoice, as if receiving the gift of God's inheritance.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:7
segments.html: Also raise your hands in holiness and say to the Almighty:

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:8
segments.html: “Blessed is Adonoy Who granted rest to His people Israel.”251 Kings 8:56

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:9
segments.html: Seekers of Adonoy, seed of Avrohom, His beloved,

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:10
segments.html: who delay departing from the Sabbath and rush to welcome it;

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:11
segments.html: who rejoice in preserving it and to place its eiruv26An eiruv is the food which must be placed before the Shabbos in order to enable one to carry from one private domain into another. Without an eiruv the Sages forbade this carrying. An eiruv is also used to enable a person to walk beyond the 2,000-cubit Shabbos boundary.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:12
segments.html: “This is the day Adonoy has made let us exult and rejoice in it.”27Psalms 118:24.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:13
segments.html: Remember the Torah of Moses, which states the Sabbath commandment28Perfect observance of the Torah’s command to keep the Shabbos is impossible without the expositions of the Talmud, commentaries, and codes.—Etz Yosef

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:14
segments.html: engraved for the seventh day like a bride adorned amid her friends.29The commandment of the Shabbos was engraved on the two tablets God gave Moses. As the fourth of the Ten Statements, it is surrounded by its sister-mitzvos.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:15
segments.html: Pure ones inherit it and sanctify it with the words, “All that He had made”30Genesis 1:31. —

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:16
segments.html: “And God completed by the seventh day, His work that He had done.”31Genesis 2:2.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:17
segments.html: It is a holy day, from arrival till departure;

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:18
segments.html: all the seed of Jacob honor it according to the King's word and decree—

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:19
segments.html: to rest on it and to rejoice with the pleasure of food and drink—

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:20
segments.html: “The entire congregation of Israel will do it.”32Exodus 12:47.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:21
segments.html: Extend Your kindness to those who know You, Almighty, jealous and vengeful.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:22
segments.html: Those who keep the seventh day, “Recall” and “Preserve,”33There are two Scriptural versions of the Ten Commandments. The commandment of the Shabbos in Exodus 20 begins with the word זָכוֹר , recall, and in Deuteronomy 5 it begins with the word שָׁמוֹר , preserve.—Etz Yosef to fulfill,

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:23
segments.html: grant them joy with rebuilt Jerusalem;34The proper observance of the Shabbos brings the ultimate redemption and the rebuilding of Jerusalem.—Siach Yitzchak and with the light of Your countenance, make them radiant.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:24
segments.html: “Let them be sated from the abundance of Your House, and from the stream of Your delights give them drink.”35Psalms 36:9.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:25
segments.html: Help those who abstain on the seventh day—from plowing and harvesting, [may You help them] always.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:26
segments.html: Those who walk on it with short strides and feast on it [eating three meals] in order to bless [You] three times—

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:27
segments.html: may their righteousness shine like the light of the seven days.36When God created the world, He created a brilliant light that lasted only during the seven days of creation. God preserved it for the righteous to enjoy in the World to Come.—Etz Yosef

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:28
segments.html: “Adonoy, God of Israel, [grant] perfect love

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:29
segments.html: Adonoy, God of Israel [grant] eternal deliverance.”

segments.html: מְנוּחָה וְשִׂמְחָה אוֹר לַיְּהוּדִים

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:2
segments.html: יוֹם שַׁבָּתוֹן יוֹם מַחֲמַדִּים

segments.html: כִּי לְשִׁשָּׁה כֹּל בְּרוּאִים וְעוֹמְדִים׃

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:5

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:6
segments.html: כָּל צְבָא מָרוֹם גְבוֹהִים וְרָמִים

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:7
segments.html: תַּנִּין וְאָדָם וְחַיַּת רְאֵמִים

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:8
segments.html: כִּי בְּיָהּ יְהֹוָה צוּר עוֹלָמִים׃

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:9
segments.html: הוּא אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לְעַם סְגֻלָּתוֹ

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:10
segments.html: שָׁמוֹר לְקַדְּשׁוֹ מִבֹּאוֹ וְעַד צֵאתוֹ

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:11
segments.html: שַׁבָּת קֹֽדֶשׁ יוֹם חֶמְדָּתוֹ

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:12
segments.html: כִּי בוֹ שָׁבַת אֵל מִכָּל מְלַאכְתּוֹ׃

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:13
segments.html: בְּמִצְוַת שַׁבָּת אֵל יַחֲלִיצָךְ

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:14
segments.html: קוּם קְרָא אֵלָיו יָחִישׁ לְאַמְּצָךְ

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:15
segments.html: נִשְׁמַת כָּל חַי וְגַם נַעֲרִיצָךְ

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:16
segments.html: אֱכֹל בְּשִׂמְחָה כִּי כְבָר רָצָךְ׃

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:17
segments.html: בְּמִשְׁנֶה לֶֽחֶם וְקִדּוּשׁ רַבָּה

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:18
segments.html: בְּרוֹב מַטְעַמִּים וְרֽוּחַ נְדִיבָה

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:19
segments.html: יִזְכּוּ לְרַב טוּב הַמִּתְעַנְּגִים בָּהּ

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:20
segments.html: בְּבִיאַת גּוֹאֵל לְחַיֵּי הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא׃

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:1
segments.html: Rest and joy, a light for the Jews.37The joy that radiates from a Jewish face on Shabbos is brighter than on any other day.—Siach Yitzchok

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:2
segments.html: It is a day of rest, a day of delights;

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:3
segments.html: its preservers and its recallers—38See note 10 to כָּל מְקַדֵּשׁ . they bear witness

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:4
segments.html: that in six [days], all was created: and it still exists.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:5
segments.html: Heavens above the skies, earth, and seas,

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:6
segments.html: all the hosts of heaven high and exalted;

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:7
segments.html: sea monsters, and man, and mighty beasts—

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:8
segments.html: for with the letters yud and hey Adonoy, created worlds.39Isaiah 26:4; See Rashi to Genesis 2:4.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:9
segments.html: He is the One Who told His treasured people—

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:10
segments.html: Be careful to sanctify it from arrival till departure—

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:11
segments.html: the holy Sabbath, day of His delight,

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:12
segments.html: for on it the Almighty abstained from all His work.40Genesis 2:2.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:13
segments.html: Through the command of the Sabbath the Almighty will strengthen you.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:14
segments.html: Arise, call out to Him—He will hasten to strengthen you—

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:15
segments.html: [Recite] “Soul of all living,”41See page 000. and also “We proclaim Your might.”42See page 000.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:16
segments.html: Eat with joy, for He has already accepted you favorably.43Koheleth 9:7.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:17
segments.html: With double loaves and a great Kiddush,

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:18
segments.html: with abundant delicacies and generous spirit,

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:19
segments.html: they will merit much good—those who delight in it

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Menucha VeSimcha:20
segments.html: —with the coming of the Redeemer in the life in the World-to-Come.

segments.html: לְבוּשׁ בִּגְדֵי חֲמוּדוֹת. לְהַדְלִיק נֵר בִּבְרָכָה.

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Ma Yedidut:4
segments.html: וַתֵּֽכֶל כָּל הָעֲבוֹדוֹת. לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ מְלָאכָה:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Ma Yedidut:5
segments.html: לְהִתְעַנֵּג בְּתַעֲנוּגִים. בַּרְבּוּרִים וּשְׂלָיו וְדָגִים:

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Ma Yedidut:6
segments.html: מֵעֶֽרֶב מַזְמִינִים. כָּל מִינֵי מַטְעַמִּים.

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Ma Yedidut:7
segments.html: מִבְּ֒עוֹד יוֹם מוּכָנִים. תַּרְנְ֒גוֹלִים מְפֻטָּמִים.

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Ma Yedidut:8
segments.html: וְלַעֲרוֹךְ כַּמָּה מִינִים. שְׁתוֹת יֵינוֹת מְבֻשָּׁמִים.

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Ma Yedidut:9
segments.html: וְתַפְנוּקֵי מַעֲדַנִּים. בְּכָל שָׁלשׁ פְּעָמִים. <small>להתענג:</small>

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Ma Yedidut:10
segments.html: נַחֲלַת יַעֲקֹב יִירָשׁ. בְּלִי מְצָרִים נַחֲלָה.

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Ma Yedidut:11
segments.html: וִיכַבְּ֒דֽוּהוּ עָשִׁיר וָרָשׁ. וְתִזְכּוּ לִגְאֻלָּה.

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Ma Yedidut:12
segments.html: יוֹם שַׁבָּת אִם תִּשְׁמֽוֹרוּ. וִהְיִֽיתֶם לִי סְגֻלָּה.

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Ma Yedidut:13
segments.html: שֵֽׁשֶׁת יָמִים תַּעֲבֽוֹדוּ. וּבַשְּׁ֒בִיעִי נָגִֽילָה. <small>להתענג:</small>

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Ma Yedidut:14
segments.html: חֲפָצֶֽיךָ בּוֹ אֲסוּרִים. וְגַם לַחֲשֹׁב חֶשְׁבּוֹנוֹת.

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Ma Yedidut:15
segments.html: הִרְהוּרִים מֻתָּרִים. וּלְשַׁדֵךְ הַבָּנוֹת.

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Ma Yedidut:16
segments.html: וְתִינוֹק לְלַמְּ֒דוֹ סֵֽפֶר. לַמְ֒נַצֵּֽחַ בִּנְגִינוֹת.

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Ma Yedidut:17
segments.html: וְלַהֲגוֹת בְּאִמְרֵי שֶֽׁפֶר. בְּכָל פִּנּוֹת וּמַחֲנוֹת. <small>להתענג:</small>

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Ma Yedidut:18
segments.html: הִלוּכָךְ תְּהֵא בְנַֽחַת. עֹנֶג קְרָא לַשַׁבָּת.

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Ma Yedidut:19
segments.html: וְהַשֵּׁנָה מְשֻׁבַּֽחַת. כְּדַת נֶֽפֶשׁ מְשִׁיבַת.

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Ma Yedidut:20
segments.html: בְּכֵן נַפְשִׁי לְךָ עָרְ֒גָה. וְלָנֽוּחַ בְּחִבַּת.

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Ma Yedidut:21
segments.html: כַּשּׁוֹשַׁנִּים סוּגָה. בּוֹ יָנֽוּחוּ בֵּן וּבַת. <small>להתענג:</small>

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Ma Yedidut:22
segments.html: מֵעֵין עוֹלָם הַבָּא. יוֹם שַׁבָּת מְנוּחָה.

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Ma Yedidut:23
segments.html: כָּל הַמִּתְעַנְּ֒גִים בָּהּ. יִזְכּוּ לְרֹב שִׂמְחָה.

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Ma Yedidut:24
segments.html: מֵחֶבְלֵי מָשִֽׁיחַ. יֻצָּֽלוּ לִרְוָחָה.

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Ma Yedidut:25
segments.html: פְּדוּתֵֽנוּ תַצְמִֽיחַ. וְנָס יָגוֹן וַאֲנָחָה. <small>להתענג:</small>

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yom zeh L'yisrael:14

segments.html: וְאַפֵּק יַת עַמָּךְ מִגּוֹ גָלוּתָא.

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:19
segments.html: עַמֵּךְ דִּי בְחַרְתְּ מִכָּל אֻמַּיָּא.

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:20
segments.html: <small>יָהּ רִבּוֹן עָלַם וְעָלְמַיָּא. אַנְתְּ הוּא מַלְכָּא מֶֽלֶךְ מַלְכַיָּא:</small>

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:21
segments.html: לְמִקְדָּשֵׁךְ תּוּב וּלְקֹֽדֶשׁ קֻדְשִׁין.

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:22
segments.html: אֲתַר דִּי בֵיהּ יֶחֱדוּן רוּחִין וְנַפְשִׁין.

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:23
segments.html: וִיזַמְּ֒רוּן לָךְ שִׁירִין וְרַחֲשִׁין.

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:24
segments.html: בִּירוּשְׁ֒לֵם קַרְתָּא דְשׁוּפְרַיָּא.

segments.html: <small>יָהּ רִבּוֹן עָלַם וְעָלְמַיָּא. אַנְתְּ הוּא מַלְכָּא מֶֽלֶךְ מַלְכַיָּא:</small>

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:1
segments.html: God, Master of all worlds,

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:2
segments.html: You are the King—the King of kings.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:3
segments.html: The work of Your might and Your wondrous deeds,

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:4
segments.html: it is fitting to declare before You. <small>refrain.</small>

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:5
segments.html: <small>God, Master of all worlds, You are the King—the King of kings.</small>

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:6
segments.html: Praises I will present morning and night

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:7
segments.html: to You, holy God Who created all life—

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:8
segments.html: holy angels and humans,

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:9
segments.html: beasts of the field and birds of the sky.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:10
segments.html: <small>God, Master of all worlds, You are the King—the King of kings.</small>

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:11
segments.html: Great are Your works and mighty—

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:12
segments.html: You humble the haughty and straighten the bent;

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:13
segments.html: were man to live a thousand years,

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:14
segments.html: he could not recount Your might.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:15
segments.html: <small>God, Master of all worlds, You are the King—the King of kings.</small>

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:16
segments.html: Almighty, to Whom belongs honor and greatness,

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:17
segments.html: redeem Your sheep from the mouths of lions,

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:18
segments.html: And bring Your people out of exile,

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:19
segments.html: Your people, whom You chose from all peoples.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:20
segments.html: <small>God, Master of all worlds, You are the King—the King of kings.</small>

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:21
segments.html: To Your Holy Temple return and to the Holy of Holies,

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:22
segments.html: the place where they will rejoice—spirits and souls;

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:23
segments.html: and they will sing to You songs and praises

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:24
segments.html: in Jerusalem, city of beauty.

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:1
segments.html: צָמְאָה נַפְשִׁי לֵאלֹהִים לְאֵל חָי

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:2
segments.html: לִבִּי וּבְשָׂרִי יְרַנְּנוּ לְאֵל חָי

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:3
segments.html: אֵל חַי בְּרָאָנִי וְאָמַר חַי אָנִי

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:4
segments.html: כִּי לֹא יִרְאַנִי הָאָדָם וָחָי

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:5
segments.html: בָּרָא כֹּל בְּחָכְמָה בְּעֵצָה וּבִמְזִמָּה

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:6
segments.html: וְנֶעֶלְמָה מֵעֵינֵי כָל חָי

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:7
segments.html: רָם עַל כֹּל כְּבוֹדוֹ כָּל פֶּה יְחַו הוֹדוֹ

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:8
segments.html: בָּרוּךְ אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדוֹ נֶפֶשׁ כָּל חָי

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:9
segments.html: הִבְדִּיל נִינֵי תָם חֻקִּים לְהוֹרוֹתָם

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:10
segments.html: אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה אוֹתָם הָאָדָם וָחָי

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:11
segments.html: מִי זֶה יִצְטַדַּק נִמְשַׁל כְּאָבָק דָּק

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:12
segments.html: אֶמֶת כִּי לֹא יִצְדַּק לְפָנֶיךָ כָּל חָי

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:13
segments.html: בְּלֵב יֵצֶר חָשׁוּב כִּדְמוּת חֲמַת עַכְשׁוּב

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:14
segments.html: וְאֵיכָכָה יָשׁוּב הַבָּשָׂר הַחָי

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:15
segments.html: נְסוֹגִים אִם אָבוּ מִדַרְכָּם שָׁבוּ

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:16
segments.html: טֶרֶם יִשְׁכָּבוּ בֵּית מוֹעֵד לְכָל חָי

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:17
segments.html: עַל כֹּל חֲסָדֶיךָ תְּחַדֵּשׁ עֵדֶיךָ

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:18
segments.html: פּוֹתֵחַ אֶת יָדֶךָ וּמַשְׂבִּיעַ לְכָל חָי

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:19
segments.html: זְכוֹר אַהֲבַת קְדוּמִים וְהַחֲיֵה נִרְדָּמִים

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:20
segments.html: וְקָרֵב הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר בֶּן יִשַׁי חָי

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:21
segments.html: רְאֵה לִגְבֶרֶת אֱמֶת שִׁפְחָה נוֹאֶמֶת

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:22
segments.html: לֹא כִי בְנֵךְ הַמֵּת וּבְנִי הֶחָי

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:23
segments.html: הֲלֹא חֶלְקְך מֵרֹאשׁ חָלָק דָּמוֹ דְרֹשׁ

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:24
segments.html: וּשְׁפֹךְ אַף עַל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׂעִיר הַחָי

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:25
segments.html: אוּלַי עֵת בָּאָה לְהָשִׁיב נְשׂוּא חֲטָאָה

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:26
segments.html: אֶל בֵּיתְךָ וְרָאָה אֹתוֹ וָחָי

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:27
segments.html: אֶפְרֹשׂ לְךָ כַּפִּי וְאֶקּוֹד עַל אַפִּי

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:28
segments.html: בְּעֵת אֶפְתַּח אֶת פִּי בְּנִשְׁמַת כָּל חָי

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:1
segments.html: My body thirsts

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:2
segments.html: for Elohim, for the Living God;

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:3
segments.html: my mind and flesh

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:4
segments.html: sing out His praises.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:6
segments.html: The one Who made me

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:7
segments.html: Said, “As I live!”

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:8
segments.html: “For no man

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:9
segments.html: May see me and live.”

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:11
segments.html: He made all with Wisdom

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:12
segments.html: With discerning counsel.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:13
segments.html: How hidden is He

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:14
segments.html: From the eyes of all life!

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:16
segments.html: High above all His host;

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:17
segments.html: They all announce his might.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:18
segments.html: Blessed be He who has in hand

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:19
segments.html: The soul of every living thing.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:21
segments.html: He selected Jacob’s family

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:22
segments.html: To teach them the Laws

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:23
segments.html: Which, if a man follow them,

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:24
segments.html: He will live.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:26
segments.html: Who could justify themselves?

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:27
segments.html: All are like dust.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:28
segments.html: Truly, none is worthy

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:29
segments.html: Before You.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:48
segments.html: Recall the ancients’ love

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:49
segments.html: Return the dead to life

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:50
segments.html: And bring near the time

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:51
segments.html: When the son of Jesse lives!

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:53
segments.html: Hark! This woman has the truth

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:54
segments.html: The reliable servant

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:55
segments.html: “No, for her son has died

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:56
segments.html: And mine lives."

segments.html: צוּר מִשֶּׁלּוֹ אָכַֽלְנוּ בָּרְכוּ אֱמוּנַי

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:2

segments.html: הַזָּן אֶת עוֹלָמוֹ רוֹעֵֽנוּ אָבִֽינוּ

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:4
segments.html: אָכַֽלְנוּ אֶת לַחְמוֹ וְיֵינוֹ שָׁתִֽינוּ

segments.html: עַל כֵּן נוֹדֶה לִשְׁמוֹ וּנְהַלְּלוֹ בְּפִֽינוּ

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:6
segments.html: אָמַֽרְנוּ וְעָנִֽינוּ אֵין קָדוֹשׁ כַּיהֹוָה׃

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:7
segments.html: <small>צוּר מִשֶּׁלּוֹ אָכַֽלְנוּ בָּרְכוּ אֱמוּנַי שָׂבַֽעְנוּ וְהוֹתַֽרְנוּ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה׃</small>

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:8
segments.html: בְּשִׁיר וְקוֹל תּוֹדָה נְבָרֵךְ לֵאלֹהֵֽינוּ

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:9
segments.html: עַל אֶֽרֶץ חֶמְדָּה טוֹבָה שֶׁהִנְחִיל לַאֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:10
segments.html: מָזוֹן וְצֵדָה הִשְׂבִּֽיעַ לְנַפְשֵֽׁנוּ

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:11
segments.html: חַסְדּוֹ גָּבַר עָלֵֽינוּ וֶאֱמֶת יְהֹוָה׃

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:12
segments.html: <small>צוּר מִשֶּׁלּוֹ אָכַֽלְנוּ בָּרְכוּ אֱמוּנַי שָׂבַֽעְנוּ וְהוֹתַֽרְנוּ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה׃</small>

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:13
segments.html: רַחֵם בְּחַסְדֶּֽךָ עַל עַמְּךָ צוּרֵֽנוּ

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:14
segments.html: עַל צִיּוֹן מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ זְבוּל בֵּית תִּפְאַרְתֵּֽנוּ

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:15
segments.html: בֶּן־דָּוִד עַבְדֶּֽךָ יָבֹא וְיִגְאָלֵֽנוּ

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:16
segments.html: רֽוּחַ אַפֵּֽינוּ מְשִֽׁיחַ יְהֹוָה׃

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:17
segments.html: <small>צוּר מִשֶּׁלּוֹ אָכַֽלְנוּ בָּרְכוּ אֱמוּנַי שָׂבַֽעְנוּ וְהוֹתַֽרְנוּ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה׃</small>

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:18
segments.html: יִבָּנֶה הַמִּקְדָּשׁ עִיר צִיּוֹן תְּמַלֵּא

segments.html: וְשָׁם נָשִׁיר שִׁיר חָדָשׁ וּבִרְנָנָה נַעֲלֶה

segments.html: הָרַחֲמָן הַנִּקְדָּשׁ יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִתְעַלֶּה

segments.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:21
segments.html: עַל כּוֹס יַֽיִן מָלֵא כְּבִרְכַּת יְהֹוָה׃

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:1
segments.html: The Rock—from His [store] we have eaten—Bless Him my faithful ones.44This verse corresponds to the phrase רַבּוֹתַי נְבָרֵךְ (See page 000) inviting the table companions to join together in saying Birchas Hamazon.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:2
segments.html: We have satisfied ourselves and we have left over [some food], according to the word of Adonoy.45This phrase refers to 2 Kings 4:43, “For thus said Adonoy, ‘They shall eat, and shall leave thereof.’”

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:3
segments.html: He nourishes His world,46The first stanza of this poem is based on the first blessing of Birchas Hamazon (See page 000). our Shepherd our Father.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:4
segments.html: We have eaten His bread and His wine we drank.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:5
segments.html: Therefore, we give thanks to His Name, and praise Him with our mouths—

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:6
segments.html: saying and chanting: There is nothing so holy as Adonoy.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:7
segments.html: <small>The Rock—from His [store] we have eaten—Bless [Him] my faithful ones. We have satisfied ourselves and we have left over [some food] according to the word of Adonoy.</small>

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:8
segments.html: With song and sound of thanksgiving we will bless our God,

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:9
segments.html: for the land so desirably good47The second stanza relates to the second blessing of Birchas Hamazon (See page 000). that He parceled out as a heritage to our fathers.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:10
segments.html: [With] food and sustenance He satisfied our souls;

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:11
segments.html: His kindliness48The third stanza parallels the third blessing of Birchas Hamazon (See page 000.) Because these three stanzas so closely resemble the blessing of Bircchas Hamazon, some authorities warn against reciting this poem after the meal for one may thus technically fulfill his obligation to recite Birchas Hamazon. According to them, one should recite or sing the song only in mid- meal. overwhelmed us and Adonoy is truth.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:12
segments.html: <small>The Rock—from His [store] we have eaten—Bless [Him] my faithful ones. We have satisfied ourselves and we have left over [some food] according to the word of Adonoy.</small>

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:13
segments.html: Be compassionate with Your kindliness upon Your people; our Rock,

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:14
segments.html: upon Zion, the dwelling-place of Your Glory, the Abode, home of our splendors.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:15
segments.html: May the son of David, Your servant, come and redeem us

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:16
segments.html: the breath of our life—the anointed of Adonoy.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:17
segments.html: <small>The Rock—from His [store] we have eaten—Bless [Him] my faithful ones. We have satisfied ourselves and we have left over [some food] according to the word of Adonoy.</small>

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:18
segments.html: May the Temple be rebuilt,49The final stanza relates to the grace when recited over a full cup of wine. the city of Zion filled,

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:19
segments.html: and there we will sing a new song, and with joyous singing we will come up.50We will come up to Jerusalem with joyous singing. Jerusalem is an elevated city and the Temple is at the highest point of Jerusalem. Thus Jews always say “We are going up to Jerusalem.”

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:20
segments.html: The Merciful One, the Sanctified One, blessed and exalted,

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:21
segments.html: over a full cup of wine, the bounty of Adonoy.

segments.id: en:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:22
segments.html: <small>The Rock—from His [store] we have eaten—Bless [Him] my faithful ones. We have satisfied ourselves and we have left over [some food] according to the word of Adonoy.</small>
